_about: 奇遇 seeds for 徐 — one authored line each, from the province's heritage; Ling grows the tale from it. `source` is what the player learns. A seed names a creature only when the creature has its card.

line.zh: 雾里一头四角白鹿，踏水不湿。
line.en: A four-horned white deer in the mist, walking on the water dry-shod.

source.zh: 《山海经·中山经》：其状如白鹿而四角，见则其邑大水。
source.en: Classic of Mountains and Seas, Central Mountains: like a white deer with four horns; where it is seen, the town floods.

line.zh: 泗水深处，渔夫说沉着一只周鼎，网到那里就发沉。
line.en: Deep in the Si, the fishermen say, lies a cauldron of Zhou; the nets grow heavy there.

source.zh: 《史记·秦始皇本纪》：始皇过彭城，使千人没水求周鼎，弗得。
source.en: Records of the Grand Historian: the First Emperor sent a thousand men into the Si for a Zhou cauldron, and found nothing.

line.zh: 彭城有一口老井，井边的老人说自己见过彭祖煮雉。
line.en: An old well in Pengcheng; the old man beside it says he saw Pengzu cook pheasant.

source.zh: 彭祖，寿八百，善为雉羹；《楚辞·天问》：彭铿斟雉帝何飨。
source.en: Pengzu, who lived eight hundred years and made pheasant broth — Heavenly Questions of the Chuci.

line.zh: 路边石碑刻着“徐偃王”三字，被摸得发亮。传说他行仁义而失国。
line.en: A roadside stele reads Xu Yanwang, rubbed bright by hands. He ruled by kindness, they say, and lost his kingdom.

source.zh: 《韩非子·五蠹》：徐偃王处汉东，地方五百里，行仁义。
source.en: Han Feizi: King Yan of Xu held five hundred li east of the Han and ruled by benevolence.

line.zh: 下邳的圯桥上，一位老者故意把鞋踢下桥，看谁肯去捡。
line.en: On the Yi bridge at Xiapi an old man kicks his shoe into the river to see who will fetch it.

source.zh: 《史记·留侯世家》：黄石公与张良，圯上授书。
source.en: Records of the Grand Historian: the Old Man of the Yellow Stone tests Zhang Liang at the bridge.

line.zh: 云龙山上有石床，僧人说山形如龙卧。
line.en: A stone bed on Mount Yunlong; the monk says the mountain lies like a dragon.

source.zh: 徐州云龙山；苏轼《放鹤亭记》。
source.en: Mount Yunlong at Xuzhou; Su Shi's Record of the Crane-Releasing Pavilion.

line.zh: 戏马台的风里，像还有马蹄声。
line.en: The wind over the Horse-Sporting Terrace still carries hoofbeats.

source.en: Xiang Yu made Pengcheng his capital and built a terrace to sport with horses.

line.zh: 芒砀山道上一条白蛇横路，樵夫不敢过。
line.en: A white snake lies across the Mangdang road; the woodcutters will not pass.

source.zh: 《史记·高祖本纪》：高祖醉行泽中，斩白蛇。
source.en: Records of the Grand Historian: Gaozu, drunk in the marsh, cut a white snake in two.

line.zh: 峄山石上有古篆，无人识得；读出一字，便有风起。
line.en: Ancient seal script on the rock of Mount Yi that no one can read; read one character aloud and a wind rises.

source.en: The Mount Yi inscription, in the small seal script of Li Si of Qin.

line.zh: 沂水边有人浴罢而歌，说春服既成。
line.en: By the Yi someone bathes and sings: the spring clothes are made.

source.zh: 《论语·先进》：浴乎沂，风乎舞雩，咏而归。
source.en: Analects: to bathe in the Yi, take the breeze at the Rain Altar, and go home singing.

line.zh: 蒙山雾中有鹤唳，樵夫说山里住着不老的人。
line.en: A crane calls in the mist on Mount Meng; the woodcutter says someone there does not grow old.

source.en: Book of Songs, Hymns of Lu: he held Gui and Meng.

line.zh: 山中有兽，形如兔而鸟喙，见人便闭眼装睡。
line.en: A beast in the hills like a hare with a bird's beak; it shuts its eyes and plays asleep when seen.

source.en: Classic of Mountains and Seas, Eastern Mountains.

line.zh: 淮水深处锁着一个水怪，铁链一动，河水就翻。
line.en: Something is chained deep in the Huai; when the iron stirs, the river turns over.

source.zh: 《古岳渎经》：禹锁淮涡水神无支祁。
source.en: The Classic of Ancient Peaks and Rivers: Yu chained the water spirit of the Huai.

line.zh: 泗水亭的亭长夜里巡逻，提着一盏不灭的灯。
line.en: The head of Sishui Post walks his rounds at night with a lamp that never goes out.

source.zh: 《史记·高祖本纪》：高祖为泗水亭长。
source.en: Records of the Grand Historian: Gaozu was once head of Sishui Post.

line.zh: 古城墙的砖上刻着两个字，老人说是大禹分九州时留下的。
line.en: Two characters cut into a brick of the old wall; the elders say they date from Yu's dividing of the Nine Provinces.

source.en: Book of Documents, Tribute of Yu: from the sea to Mount Dai and the Huai lies Xu.

line.zh: 淮边渔村唱着古老的歌，说祖先曾是淮夷。
line.en: A fishing village on the Huai sings an old song of ancestors who were the Huai Yi.

source.en: Tribute of Yu: the Huai Yi brought pearls and fish.

line.zh: 淮水的蚌里有珠，夜里发光。
line.en: Pearls in the Huai's mussels glow at night.

source.en: Tribute of Yu: the pearls of the Huai Yi.

line.zh: 泗水之滨有石，击之如磬。
line.en: A stone on the bank of the Si rings like a chime when struck.

source.en: Tribute of Yu: the sounding stones of the Si's shore.

line.zh: 峄山南面独生一棵桐，琴师说非它不可。
line.en: A lone paulownia on the south face of Mount Yi; the lute-maker says no other will do.

source.en: Tribute of Yu: the lone paulownia of Yi's sunny side.

line.zh: 山谷里落下五彩的雉羽，古时是贡品。
line.en: Five-coloured pheasant feathers fall in the valley; once they were tribute.

source.en: Tribute of Yu: the summer pheasants of the Feather Valley.

line.zh: 湖上采菱的女子唱着歌，船过处菱叶合拢。
line.en: Girls gathering water chestnuts sing on the lake; the leaves close behind their boat.

source.en: The Water-Chestnut Song of the Music Bureau.

line.zh: 一座山上寸草不生，风过时像有人说话。
line.en: A mountain where nothing grows; when the wind passes it sounds like speech.

source.en: Classic of Mountains and Seas, Eastern Mountains: nothing grows upon it.

line.zh: 水里游着一样东西，像一叶肺，有眼六足，口中含珠。
line.en: Something swims in the water like a lung, with eyes and six legs, a pearl in its mouth.

source.en: Classic of Mountains and Seas, Eastern Mountains.

line.zh: 一只狐狸张开翅膀，从树梢飞过。
line.en: A fox spreads wings and flies over the treetops.

source.zh: 《山海经·东山经》：状如狐而有翼。
source.en: Classic of Mountains and Seas, Eastern Mountains: like a fox, with wings.

line.zh: 古墓的石壁上刻着车马与神仙，车轮像还在转。
line.en: Carriages and immortals cut into the stone of an old tomb; the wheels seem to turn.

source.en: The Han pictorial stones of Xuzhou.

line.zh: 老人指着沙地说，那曾是黄河的河床。
line.en: An old man points at the sand: that was the bed of the Yellow River.

source.zh: 黄河夺泗入淮，宋建炎二年。
source.en: The Yellow River seized the Si and ran into the Huai, 1128.

line.zh: 燕子楼上一位女子守着灯，等一个不回的人。
line.en: In the Swallow Tower a woman keeps a lamp for someone who will not return.

source.zh: 徐州燕子楼，关盼盼；白居易《燕子楼》诗。
source.en: The Swallow Tower of Xuzhou and Guan Panpan; Bai Juyi's poem.

line.zh: 云龙山人放两只鹤，清晨飞去，日暮归来。
line.en: The hermit of Yunlong releases two cranes: away at dawn, home at dusk.

source.en: Su Shi, Record of the Crane-Releasing Pavilion.

line.zh: 彭城有一座黄楼，说是以土克水，镇住河患。
line.en: A Yellow Tower stands in Pengcheng, built so earth would conquer water and hold the floods.

source.zh: 苏轼知徐州，筑黄楼；五行土克水。
source.en: Su Shi, governing Xuzhou, built the Yellow Tower — earth conquers water among the five phases.

line.zh: 淮上有渡口，船家说船只渡人，不渡心事。
line.en: A ferry on the Huai; the boatman says it carries people, not their troubles.

source.en: A saying of the Huai ferries.

line.zh: 泗水渔翁夜得一鲤，鲤能言。
line.en: A Si River fisherman nets a carp at night; the carp can speak.

source.en: In the manner of Liaozhai — no single source

line.zh: 客栈里书生夜读，窗外有人应声。
line.en: A scholar reads aloud at an inn by night; outside the window, someone answers.

source.en: In the manner of Liaozhai — no single source

line.zh: 渡口的船家说，子夜的船不能上，那船是渡别人的。
line.en: The ferryman says never board the midnight boat — it is crossing for others.

source.en: In the manner of Liaozhai — no single source

line.zh: 田埂上走着一盏灯，没有提灯的人。
line.en: A lamp walks the field path with no one carrying it.

source.en: In the manner of Liaozhai — no single source

line.zh: 古井夜里传出磬声，一下，又一下。
line.en: A chime sounds from the old well at night — once, and again.

source.zh: 《尚书·禹贡》：泗滨浮磬；聊斋之风。
source.en: The sounding stones of the Si; in the manner of Liaozhai.

line.zh: 山路上灯火成行，说是狐仙嫁女。
line.en: Lanterns in a line along the mountain road: the fox spirits, they say, are marrying a daughter.

source.en: In the manner of Liaozhai — no single source

line.zh: 老僧夜半敲门借火，天亮才知那庙早已荒废。
line.en: An old monk knocks at midnight to borrow fire; at dawn you learn his temple has lain in ruins for years.

source.en: In the manner of Liaozhai — no single source

line.zh: 月下有人在戏马台上舞剑，走近只有风。
line.en: Someone dances with a sword on the Horse-Sporting Terrace under the moon; up close, only wind.

source.en: Xiang Yu's terrace; in the manner of Liaozhai.

line.zh: 沂水的鹅卵石在夜里排成了字。
line.en: The pebbles of the Yi arrange themselves into characters at night.

source.en: In the manner of Liaozhai — no single source

line.zh: 一只白鹿的影子从雾里经过，却不见鹿。
line.en: The shadow of a white deer passes through the mist, and no deer.

source.zh: 《山海经·中山经》夫诸；聊斋之风。
source.en: The Fuzhu of the Central Mountains; in the manner of Liaozhai.
